case_notes.fixture_d2_base_rebound: NO_CLAIM: byte-identical slot labels, but the base register is rebound on every path
case_notes.fixture_d2_caller_saved_base: NO_CLAIM: the base register is caller-saved, so the release call itself may clobber it
case_notes.fixture_d2_conditional_pair: both releases on one arm: conditional is not a refusal, the arm frees twice
case_notes.fixture_d2_field_positive: two loads of one untouched object's field with no reset in between
case_notes.fixture_d2_field_reset: NO_CLAIM: the field is reset to NULL after the first release
case_notes.fixture_d2_loop_carried: NO_CLAIM: the aio_multi_delete shape -- two sites inside a loop, the register is reloaded per iteration, so each iteration releases a different object
case_notes.fixture_d2_refcount_guarded: NO_CLAIM: both sites run only when the reference count reached zero, which no single path can observe twice
case_notes.fixture_d2_register_positive: two releases of one callee-saved register, never rewritten between them
case_notes.fixture_d2_register_rebound_all_paths: NO_CLAIM: the same register label holds a different object on every path to the second release
